title: Track Selection Across Staging
description: Moves the selection to the other side of the index when the file is staged/unstaged.
signature: export function followAcrossIndex(open: { path: string; staged: boolean } | null, paths: string[], wasStagedBefore: boolean): { path: string; staged: boolean } | null
params: open: { path: string; staged: boolean } | null
semantics: Moves selection to the opposite staged value if the open file is in the affected paths list.
